title: The Immortal Life of Henrietta Lacks

questions.q: What type of cancer was Henrietta Lacks diagnosed with?
questions.why: The text states her biopsy revealed stage I cervical cancer.

questions.q: Which laboratory tool originated from Henrietta's cells?
questions.why: Her cells became the widely used HeLa cell line.

questions.q: How did Henrietta's family first learn about her contribution to medicine?
questions.why: The daughter was told by the doctors who cared for her.

questions.q: What treatment did Henrietta receive that caused severe burns?
questions.why: She endured hours of radium exposure that burned her.

questions.q: Which later case highlighted similar ethical issues as Henrietta's cell use?
a: A leukemia patient whose cells were sold without consent
A heart transplant donor without family permission
A DNA database used without notice
questions.why: The text mentions a leukemia patient whose cells were marketed without his knowledge.
